name: paperwork-pilot
description: Life-event bureaucracy navigator for India (Bengaluru first). Guidance, not legal advice.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
